fact: The Ministry of National Economy, through the Commission de la Concurrence (COMCO), launched the 'Loba' chatbot from the week of 1 May 2026 to help consumers file complaints in regulated sectors including public health and electricity, with a pilot phase in Kinshasa before extension to the provinces, per the ministry communique reported by ACP.
The electricity regulator ARE presented on 5 October 2026 an online platform where consumer and operator complaints can be filed and tracked.
